pb-social-scheduled.heading: Scheduled posts
pb-social-scheduled.boundary: Approve one exact post and time. Keep this desktop open. A restart needs a new approval. LinkedIn stays copy-and-open.
pb-social-scheduled.consent: Chausar will post in a browser window on this computer. Please don't type in that window until the post is done.
pb-social-scheduled.risk: The platform may restrict this account.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.draft: Review this exact post and time before approving the slot.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.empty: There is nothing ready for this slot. No post was sent.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.busy: Another post is going out. This slot will wait for up to sixty minutes.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.missed: This slot was missed because no post went out within sixty minutes.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.restart: This posting approval is no longer in this session. Review and approve a new slot again.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.changed: The post or its source files changed since review. Review and approve a new slot.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.cancelled: You cancelled this slot. No new post will start.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.scheduled: This exact slot is approved. Keep this desktop business open until it runs.
pb-social-scheduled.error.SLOT_STALE: This slot changed. Review it again.
pb-social-scheduled.error.SLOT_NOT_FOUND: That scheduled slot was not found.
pb-social-scheduled.error.SLOT_FROZEN: This slot is already decided. Create a new slot for a change.
pb-social-scheduled.error.SLOT_TIME_INVA: Choose a future time within one year.
pb-social-scheduled.error.SLOT_DESKTOP_O: Scheduled posts run only in this desktop business.
pb-social-scheduled.error.POST_NOT_FOUND: Choose a waiting post in this business and channel.
pb-social-scheduled.error.NOT_BUILT_YET: This channel cannot post here. Copy the approved post and open the platform yourself.
pb-social-scheduled.error.REQUEST_FAILED: The slot could not be saved. Review the current post and try again.
pb-social-scheduled.error.ACCOUNT_FENCE: The signed-in account changed or cannot be identified. Sign in and review a new slot.
pb-social-scheduled.error.POST_ALREADY_D: This post has already started. Check its outcome.
pb-social-scheduled.reason.forgotten: This slot was cancelled because it named someone you asked Chausar to forget.
